subject: Hiring gate framework & band-exception request — Platform Eng
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hiring gate framework & band-exception request — Platform Eng

Team —

We have an urgent ask from Acme Systems (external hiring manager Emily Chen) to accelerate a senior infra engineer req. Their timeline moved up due to a vendor sunset; they need a candidate in-seat by early October. The role is already budgeted but sits in Q4 headcount; the hiring manager is requesting:

- move one FTE from the Q4 buffer into Platform Eng (headcount reallocation)
- an offer band exception: midpoint +8% (junior of the senior band)

Im drafting the formal request but wanted quick alignment on the gating rules before I escalate: we currently have a hiring gate that requires finance OK + VP approval for any cross-quarter shifts and anything that adjusts target comp by >5%.

Questions:
1) Is there appetite to approve a one-off band exception to meet the timeline?
2) If we approve the band change, do we hold the offer until a formal reconciliation with Finance or can we ship with a conditional note?

Id like to share a short mutual action plan with Acme and TalentOps this week if we can get a directional yes. Attaching the BandException_Form and the req approval template for reference.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Head of Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: BandException_Form.pdf, Req-Approval-Template.docx

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 23 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hiring gate framework & band-exception request — Platform Eng

Thanks Marcus —

Quick notes from Talent Ops / TA process standpoint:

- For headcount reallocation between quarters we need written sign-off from the hiring VP (Lauren) and a Finance acknowledgement. For small moves (<=1 FTE) TA can provisionally open the req but we cannot extend an offer until Finance confirms funding or it is covered by a specific reserve.
- Band exceptions >5% require a Band Exception Form (attached) plus an approvals chain: Hiring Manager -> Hiring VP -> TotalComp -> CFO (or delegated signatory).
- If you need to move faster, we can run a conditional offer ("subject to finance reconciliation and formal sign-off") but that must be cleared with Legal and be explicitly time-limited in the offer letter. Historically that has worked for high-priority channel partners but adds complexity to acceptance/withdrawal risk.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Marcus to confirm exact band target and proposed offer structure (base, equity target, sign-on)
2) Lauren to indicate whether shes willing to approve a one-time reallocation and the band uplift as exception
3) TA to queue the req as provisional and set a 10-business-day clock for Finance review if Lauren approves

Im copying in the BandException_Form.pdf and the Offer-Approval-Checklist.txt for the list of signatories.

Laura Bennett
Director, Talent Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: BandException_Form.pdf, Offer-Approval-Checklist.txt

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hiring gate framework & band-exception request — Platform Eng

Marcus / Laura —

I reviewed the ask and the external timeline. I can approve a one-time headcount reallocation from the Q4 buffer into Platform Eng on the condition that:

- the band exception is capped at +8% of midpoint and total comp remains within the approved band ceiling when equity is factored in;
- TA files the req as provisional and the offer is issued with the following language: "Offer contingent on Finance reconciliation within 10 business days";
- Finance (ccd below) needs to ack within that 10-day window or the hire is paused and the candidate can be offered a revised package at standard band;
- we will limit this to a single headcount; any additional cross-quarter moves require a broader rebase discussion.

Aditya: please loop Finance (CFO or delegated) immediately and ask for a quick funding ack. If Finance declines, we will not move forward.

If everyone is aligned Ill sign the req approval today. Marcus, please confirm the proposed LOE for comp and sign-on so Laura can complete the form.

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop
VP, People Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hiring gate framework & band-exception request — Platform Eng

Thanks Lauren — all clear.

Confirming proposed offer:
- Base: $168,000 (midpoint +8%)
- Equity: target 0.25% over 4 years
- Sign-on: $15,000 one-time

Ill send the BandException_Form filled and well ask TalentOps to open the provisional req immediately. Copying Emily at Acme to set candidate expectations.

Marcus
Head of Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
